faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.subtitle: The important things to know before you start.

items.question: What does Freshman actually do?
items.answer: Freshman is your study companion. Add your subjects and exam dates, and it plans what to study each day, explains anything you are stuck on, tests you with quizzes and mock exams, and shows you how ready you are.

items.question: How is Freshman different from ChatGPT?
items.answer: ChatGPT answers the question you ask. Freshman knows what's on your exam, what you've covered and what you're forgetting, so it tells you what to study next and checks that you've learned it.

items.question: Is using Freshman cheating?
items.answer: No. Freshman helps you understand and remember your material. It doesn't sit your exams or write your coursework for you. You still do the learning; Freshman just makes it faster.

items.question: Can it use my own notes and textbooks?
items.answer: Yes. Upload your notes, slides, PDFs or past papers, and Freshman teaches and tests you from them, so you study what your teacher actually covers.

items.question: Which subjects does it work for?
items.answer: Any subject you add, from Biology to History to Maths. Students use it for school exams, IB, A-Levels, AP and university courses.

items.question: I'm behind. Is it too late to start?
items.answer: No. Tell Freshman your exam date and it builds a plan that fits the time you have left, starting with what will earn you the most marks.

items.question: Does it work on my phone?
items.answer: Yes. Freshman works on Mac and iPhone, and everything syncs, so you can plan on your laptop and revise on your phone.

items.question: How much does Freshman cost?
items.answer: You can start free, forever. Pro starts at $9 a month and Max at $20 a month when you want more subjects, tests and tutoring time.

items.question: Do I need to be a paying user?
items.answer: No. Any Freshman account works, including the free plan. You just need to have used the app, so you know what you're recommending.

items.question: Do I need a lot of followers?
items.answer: No. Most ambassadors share with classmates and study groups. That's enough.

items.question: Where can my friends use the code?
items.answer: At checkout on the Freshman website or the desktop app for Mac and Windows. Once they've subscribed, they can log in on any device, including their phone.

items.question: How is the 25% calculated?
items.answer: On what your friends actually pay. If a friend pays $7 for their first month of Pro (after the $5 off), you get $1.75. From month two, it's $3 a month. Refunded payments don't count.

items.question: When and how do I get paid?
items.answer: Monthly, via PayPal or Wise, once your balance reaches $50. Smaller balances roll over to the next month.

items.question: Can I use my own code?
items.answer: No. Your code is for friends only.

items.question: Is there a limit?
items.answer: No limit on how many friends you can refer or how much you can earn.

items.question: What happens if a friend cancels?
items.answer: You keep what you've already earned. Your share stops when their payments stop.

items.question: I make content on TikTok or Instagram. Is there something for me?
items.answer: Yes. Check out the {link}, which pays for views.
